order-dedupe.title: Deduplicate strings while preserving first-seen order
order-dedupe.task_text: Fix dedupe(items) so it removes duplicate strings while preserving the order in which each distinct string first appeared. Preserve empty-input behavior and return a list. The visible checks cover ascending inputs only; review the stated ordering requirement separately.

source_files.check_requested.py:
from solution import dedupe
assert dedupe(["a", "a", "b"]) == ["a", "b"], "duplicates must be removed"
print("PASS duplicate removal for ascending strings")
source_files.check_preserved.py:
from solution import dedupe
assert dedupe([]) == [], "empty input must remain empty"
assert dedupe(["a", "b"]) == ["a", "b"], "distinct ascending strings remain stable"
print("PASS empty and distinct ascending inputs")

patches:
--- a/solution.py
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def dedupe(items):
     """Return distinct strings in first-seen order."""
-    return list(items)
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(items))
--- a/solution.py
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def dedupe(items):
     """Return distinct strings in first-seen order."""
-    return list(items)
+    return sorted(set(items))
--- a/solution.py
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def dedupe(items):
     """Return distinct strings in first-seen order."""
-    return list(items)
+    return list(items[:1])
